By tenure at current firm, total cash 
compensation has also, on the whole, 
decreased for those with fewer years 
of tenure and increased for those 
with six or more years of tenure. For 
longer-tenured partners, there were 
more respondents with compensation 
in the $2 million to $3 million range 
in 2022, whereas in 2024 there are 
more respondents in the $1 million 
to $2 million range. From this, we 
infer that this is likely a market-driven 
drop in performance bonuses.
